# 全仓源码注释审查统一规范

任务 `source-comments-20261014-01a13a81`。只添加有证据的中文解释性注释，不改行为、公共 API、断言、配置语义或宏 token。保留已有注释，不复述名称、赋值或逐行实现。

## 范围和证据

清单包含第一方产品、公共契约、Runtime、Editor、插件、Hub、工具、示例、测试、着色器、模板和执行文本资源。核对跟踪与第一方未跟踪文件。排除 dev/、third_party/、外部 submodule、vendored 第三方、生成适配器/代码、构建缓存、锁文件、二进制。zircon_runtime/build 是源码，不能按目录名排除。只读文件也列审查，写权限不足不作为排除理由。

账本逐文件记录路径、语言、模块、初始/当前 SHA-256、初始 HEAD、owner、批次、状态、审查记录及问题编号。pending、assigned、reviewed、verified、committed 为阶段；waiting-owner、read-error、needs-recheck 均未完成。内容变化使原审查失效，不自动接纳新哈希。 本任务的 reviewed-local、accepted-local-review 只表示人工审查或本地格式/解析证据；formal_acceptance 为独立字段，必须有实际 Jenkins 回执。needs-comments 与 waiting-owner 仍未完成。新增、删除、分类变化显式登记。

每个对象及语句块必须人工审查，记录定义、直接调用、trait 实现、宏生成、动态注册、FFI 入口、测试和契约。记录声明列表及块进入路径、状态变化和后续影响；未发现某类入口要注明检索范围。自动枚举不等于审查完成。

## 文档与问题

Rust //! 说明模块职责、边界、主调用链、状态所有者和生命周期；/// 说明公共声明及重要私有契约；// 解释不变量、非显然顺序和理由。其他语言使用合法等价注释。中文 Markdown summary 后按实情使用调用时机、参数、返回、约束与生命周期、错误、参考等节，覆盖职责、何时用、必要前提、资源有效期及后续影响；无参数/返回不加空节。类型说明字段/状态组合与创建/传递/释放边界；参数讲语义、单位和所有权，引用必须查证。现有说明充分可不加，审查记录注明依据，不机械套模板。

新增问题编号统一使用 CR-ZCA-<批次>-<四位序号>，由主审分配；此格式与实际 change guard 的 CR-前缀/四位尾号检查一致。已登记的 ZCA-M001-001 及所有既有编号保持，避免迁移既有标签。已证明缺陷在错误调用附近写 BUG: [编号] 触发条件、可观察影响、复现或可证明路径；未确认意图写 TODO: [编号] 待确认问题、现有证据和缺口、下一步验证。BUG 不得凭猜测。unsafe 已证实前提用 SAFETY: 说明指针、大小、对齐、有效期、独占性及保障方；未知前提不能标为已安全。既有 TODO/BUG 原样保留并登记 preexisting，新增标签与问题账本一一对应。

## 归属与验证

子审跨仓只读，只编辑主审精确授予且无外来改动的文件和自己的批次记录；编辑前核对哈希和 diff，外来变化立即停该文件并交接。不提交、不构建、生成、清理、不建源码副本、不使用退役协调器。总账本由主审维护。

主审独立读每批注释和调用证据，核对所有对象/块、标签、生命周期、参数与返回；检查注释外 token/AST 不变。精确路径 git diff --check，按语言只读格式/解析；Rust 用 rustfmt --check --edition 2021 --config skip_children=true，既有格式差异单列，不自动格式化。纯注释不例行宽泛 Cargo 测试，Jenkins 实际验证门槛保持。

批次交接精确路径、base、before/after 哈希、依赖和审查/验证记录至 .jenkins/records。Jenkins 执行阶段提交、受管验证和产物维护，保全索引及外来改动。请求、dry-run、队列和待协调不算通过。全仓完成须最终哈希全覆盖、待处理零、标签一致和实际提交/维护回执。

//! Runtime 导航回调的注册与派发入口，向外导出 [`UiNavigationDispatcher`]。
//! 路由由 Surface 准备，处理器决议由此层收集，焦点提交仍由 Surface 完成。

objects.name: HashMap, Arc and navigation contract imports
objects.audit: These use declarations bind the standard collections/ownership types, Runtime dedup helper and neutral Interface route/effect/result/node/tree types used by the implementation. They create no runtime state or callback registration.
objects.documentation_decision: No per-import comments: type and method contracts describe the meaningful ownership and behavior boundaries.

objects.name: NavigationHandler
objects.audit: Private Arc-owned trait object for a callback accepting UiNavigationDispatchContext with any route lifetime and returning an owned effect. Send, Sync and static constrain the stored callback; dispatch calls Fn synchronously.
objects.documentation_decision: Added two Chinese lines for Arc ownership and per-call route borrowing; the alias type and bounds are unchanged.
objects.lifecycle: The registry owns its Arc references. A route/context reference is borrowed only during the synchronous callback. The effect has no route lifetime.

objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher
objects.audit: Owns a HashMap from (UiNodeId, UiNavigationEventKind) to a vector of registered callbacks. Default derives an empty map; the map's iteration order is irrelevant because dispatch performs direct keyed lookup.
objects.documentation_decision: Added responsibility, empty default, per-key order, owned results and Surface commit reference.

members.name: handlers
members.audit: A key identifies one node/kind; register appends Arc callbacks to its vector and dispatch borrows that vector. No serde or external registry owns this state.
members.documentation_decision: Kept the private field without a separate repetitive doc because type/register docs now explain its key, ownership and insertion order.

objects.name: impl UiNavigationDispatcher
objects.audit: Inherent methods separate mutable registration from shared dispatch. There is no custom Drop, serde implementation, external ABI or trait implementation in this impl.
objects.documentation_decision: No impl-level doc: the type and each public method now carry the relevant contracts.

objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher::register
objects.audit: For a node/kind key, creates the vector if absent and appends Arc::new(handler). It returns unit, does not invoke the callback and does not check node existence. Matching callbacks later run in vector insertion order.
objects.documentation_decision: Added summary, parameter semantics, callback bounds/ownership, use timing and link to dispatch; no empty unit-return section.

parameters.name: self
parameters.contract: Exclusive borrow of the registry during append.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.contract: Registration key component; no tree is available to validate it.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.contract: Generic F satisfying the explicit HRTB Fn + Send + Sync + static bounds, moved into Arc.

objects.returns: Unit. The next matching dispatch can observe the newly appended callback.

objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher::dispatch
objects.audit: Consumes a supplied route, selects bubbled nodes when target is Some and root targets otherwise, deduplicates first occurrences, and invokes matching callbacks in registration order. Unhandled is not recorded. First Handled or valid Focus records one invocation and stops the outer route loop. Focus checks existence through the read-only tree before recording; the returned result owns the original route and optional target.
objects.documentation_decision: Added timing, parameters, owned return, MissingNode condition, ordering, deduplication, Surface/default-navigation boundary and verified Surface method reference. Added one private capacity rationale at the initialization block.

parameters.name: self
parameters.contract: Shared registry borrow; Fn callbacks are synchronously called on the current thread.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.contract: Shared tree borrow used by the Focus branch to check target existence; this method does not commit focus.

parameters.name: route
parameters.contract: Owned route whose candidate vector order is accepted as supplied; moved into the result on success.

objects.returns: Result<UiNavigationDispatchResult, UiTreeError>; success has the original route and zero/one recorded non-Unhandled effect. A missing Focus target returns MissingNode immediately.

control_points.effect: target Some selects bubbled; target None selects root_targets.

control_points.name: empty fast path
control_points.effect: Either candidates or global handler map empty returns constructor-empty result.

control_points.name: ordered route loop
control_points.effect: Iterate the selected slice in its provided order.

control_points.effect: A repeated node skips before handler lookup.

control_points.name: missing key continue
control_points.effect: Only the exact node/kind callback vector is invoked.

control_points.name: Unhandled branch
control_points.effect: Continue handlers without storing an invocation.

control_points.name: Handled outer break
control_points.effect: Store one invocation and handled_by, then stop every later handler/node.

control_points.name: Focus existence/error branch
control_points.effect: Missing target returns MissingNode through ? before recording.

control_points.name: valid Focus outer break
control_points.effect: Store one invocation, handler and focus target, then stop the route.

control_points.name: owned result
control_points.effect: Move the original route and local records into Ok result.
